weaponTypes.name: Pistol
weaponTypes.description: Sidearm-class weapons; fast swap, moderate damage, common as a backup slot.

weaponTypes.name: Submachine Gun (SMG)
weaponTypes.description: High fire-rate, close-range weapons with fast reloads.

weaponTypes.name: Assault Rifle
weaponTypes.description: Balanced mid-range weapons, the most versatile weapon class.

weaponTypes.name: Shotgun
weaponTypes.description: Multi-pellet, high burst-damage weapons for close range.

weaponTypes.name: Sniper Rifle
weaponTypes.description: High single-shot damage, long range, weakspot-focused.

weaponTypes.name: Light Machine Gun (LMG)
weaponTypes.description: Large magazines and sustained fire, pairs well with the Fast Gunner effect.

weaponTypes.name: Bow / Crossbow
weaponTypes.description: Silent, high per-shot damage ranged weapons, often crit-focused.

weaponTypes.name: Heavy Weapon
weaponTypes.description: Grenade/rocket launchers and other explosive/AoE weapons.

weaponTypes.name: Melee Weapon
weaponTypes.description: Close-quarters weapons such as batons, blades, axes and pikes.

weapons.name: DE.50
weapons.notes: Base pistol chassis that named legendary variants are built from.

weapons.name: DE.50 — Jaws
weapons.notes: One of the higher-ranked legendary pistols.

weapons.name: R500
weapons.notes: Base pistol chassis that named legendary variants are built from.

weapons.name: KV-SBR — Little Jaws
weapons.notes: Legendary SMG with a very high fire rate for close-range fights.

weapons.name: SOCR — Outsider
weapons.notes: High damage with decent fire rate and magazine size.

weapons.name: KAM — Abyss Glance
weapons.notes: Legendary assault rifle, balanced damage and fire rate.

weapons.name: AUG — Electron Cloud
weapons.notes: Named AUG variant; flexibility adjusted in patch 2.4.1's balance pass.

weapons.name: DB12 — Raining Cash
weapons.notes: Legendary shotgun, strong burst close-range damage.

weapons.name: AWS.338
weapons.notes: Base sniper rifle chassis; the community also references a legendary variant of this line as 'Bullseye' or 'Bingo' depending on the source/version.

weapons.name: AWS.338 — Bingo
weapons.notes: Legendary sniper rifle, very high per-shot damage for weakspot hunting.

weapons.name: SN700 — Finale
weapons.notes: Reverb-stacking legendary sniper; rebalanced in patch 3.0.2 (reverb stacks reduced to 4, damage scaling adjusted).

weapons.name: SN700 — Gulped Lore
weapons.notes: Named SN700 variant, useful vs. bosses.

weapons.name: MG4 — Predator
weapons.notes: Signature weapon for Fast Gunner builds; 75-round mag lets players fire roughly 200 rounds before reloading when built around Fast Gunner.

weapons.name: KVD — Boom! Boom!
weapons.notes: 100-round magazine; considered one of the two strongest weapons in the game.

weapons.name: Aurora Fort
weapons.notes: 90-round magazine, very high per-shot damage for an LMG.

weapons.name: Rustic Crossbow
weapons.notes: The first weapon crafted during the tutorial; no unique abilities.

weapons.name: Recurve Crossbow
weapons.notes: Applies the 'Bull's Eye' debuff when hitting a weakspot.

weapons.name: Compound Bow
weapons.notes: Top-tier PvE burst weapon; excellent weakspot/crit damage, silent shots. Obtained from world weapon crates.

weapons.name: Recursive Crossbow
weapons.notes: Unique aux-weapon utility: can increase crit rate of all weapons by 30% for 10 seconds.

weapons.name: Stun Baton
weapons.notes: 80% chance to inflict the Power Surge status effect with light strikes/impacts; strong crowd-control pick.

weapons.name: Long Axe
weapons.notes: Considered the top-ranked melee weapon in community guides.

weapons.name: Frozen Northern Pike
weapons.notes: Heavy attacks freeze the primary target and generate a Frost Vortex.

weapons.name: The Fabled Masamune
weapons.notes: Grants +3% Crit Damage (up to +120%) for every 1% of durability above 50% — rewards keeping it well-maintained.

weapons.name: Torch
weapons.notes: Early/utility melee weapon, doubles as a light source.

weapons.name: MGL
weapons.notes: Grenade launcher, strong against grouped enemies and structures.

note: Once Human's full arsenal spans 126+ individual weapons (per oncehumandb.com) once every named legendary variant of each base chassis (DE.50, R500, MPS5/7, KV-SBR, SOCR, KAM, DB12, AWS.338, SN700, HAMR, MG4, KVD, etc.) is counted separately. The list above is a broad, sourced cross-section across all 9 weapon categories and every rarity tier — base chassis plus their notable named variants — rather than a literal enumeration of all 126+ entries. Turret/emplacement 'heavy weapons' like Gatling Cannons and plasma-round turrets are catalogued under Blueprints → Defense instead, since they're placed structures rather than carried weapons.
